Features in Concentrix Intelligence Hub
🤖Smart Intelligence
Auto-detects columns, builds dashboard instantly
⚙️Custom Intelligence
Full control over 24 chart types & all parameters
📋Executive Briefing
AI-written leadership summary with auto-insights
📊24 Chart Types
Bar, Line, Pie, Heatmap, Waterfall, Gauge & more
🔍Global Filters
Filter all charts simultaneously by any column
📅Date Range Picker
Filter across all charts by date range
🔎Search in Chart
Highlight matching bars/slices in any chart
▶Presentation Mode
Full-screen slideshow with auto-advance timer
💾Save/Load Config
Save setup, reload with new data next week
📄Export PDF
Dashboard as professional multi-page PDF report
📊Export PPT
Charts exported as PowerPoint presentation slides
🔗Share Dashboard
Read-only shareable URL, no server needed
📅Sheet Picker
Multi-sheet Excel with live preview per sheet
🗂Column Profiles
Data types, stats, null rates, top values
📈Trend & Forecast
Regression lines + forward projections on charts
🎨CNX Brand Theme
Concentrix navy & teal brand applied throughout
